fusions.name: Overhand Ruin
fusions.desc: Brings the edge down with all your weight, dealing 40 damage, making the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Barging Cleave
fusions.desc: Cleaves through a wide cone 3 tiles long, dealing 14 damage to everything in it and knocking each one back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Shoulder Into It
fusions.desc: Increases your slashing damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Through the Guard
fusions.desc: Your slashing attacks ignore 12% of the target's armour.
